description: Source code for a ColorConverter class handling YUV to RGB conversions, including media image support, using libyuv and NEON optimizations.

classes.name: ColorConverter
classes.description: Handles color space conversions between YUV and RGB formats, supporting media image formats and optimized libyuv pathways.

classes.name: ColorConverter::ColorSpace
classes.description: Represents color space parameters including standard, range, and transfer characteristics.

classes.name: ColorConverter::BitmapParams
classes.description: Encapsulates bitmap parameters such as dimensions, format, stride, and cropping info.

classes.name: ColorConverter::Image
classes.description: Wraps MediaImage2 for YUV media image handling, providing plane offset/stride calculations and format checks.

classes.name: ColorConverter::Coeffs
classes.description: Holds matrix coefficients for YUV to RGB conversion based on standards like BT.601, BT.709, BT.2020.

methods.name: ColorConverter::convert
methods.description: Performs color space conversion between source and destination formats with cropping and stride handling.

methods.name: ColorConverter::setSrcMediaImage2
methods.description: Sets the source media image for conversion, supporting flexible YUV formats.

methods.name: ColorConverter::isValidForMediaImage2
methods.description: Checks if current source media image and formats are valid for conversion.

methods.name: ColorConverter::isValid
methods.description: Validates if the current source and destination formats are supported for conversion.

methods.name: ColorConverter::isDstRGB
methods.description: Checks if the destination format is an RGB format.

methods.name: ColorConverter::setSrcColorSpace
methods.description: Configures the source color space parameters.

methods.name: ColorConverter::convertCbYCrY
methods.description: Converts interleaved YUV422 CbYCrY format to RGB565.

methods.name: ColorConverter::convertYUV420PlanarUseLibYUV
methods.description: Uses libyuv to convert YUV420 planar to various RGB formats.

methods.name: ColorConverter::convertYUV420SemiPlanarUseLibYUV
methods.description: Uses libyuv to convert YUV420 semi-planar to various RGB formats.

methods.name: ColorConverter::convertYUV420Planar16
methods.description: Converts 16-bit planar YUV420 to Y410 or other formats.

methods.name: ColorConverter::convertYUVP010
methods.description: Converts YUV P010 format to 10-bit RGBA format.

methods.name: ColorConverter::convertYUVP010ToRGBA1010102
methods.description: Converts YUV P010 to RGBA 1010102 format.

methods.name: ColorConverter::getMatrix
methods.description: Retrieves the appropriate color conversion matrix based on color space and format.
